name: Fresh confirmation of the fixed conservative distinctive-token branch
question: Does the already fixed high-confidence, roster-unique exact-or-one-edit distinctive-token branch produce unique correct search-priority candidates on both fresh two-producer targets without a wrong-target match?

runtime.execution: uv isolated Python 3.11 environment; frozen local PP-OCRv6 medium ONNX detector and recognizer; CPU inference

target_roster.entity_name: Département du Calvados - Direction de la Culture

name_token_contract.normalization: Unicode NFKD ASCII fold, lowercase alphanumeric tokens

distinctive_edit_token_contract.apostrophe_or_token_fragment_rule: For a row with two or three normalized tokens, also test their concatenation; this converts p + tits to ptits without changing OCR text.
distinctive_edit_token_contract.evidence_weighting: Each distinct matched target token of length 6-7 contributes one unit; length >=8 contributes two units. A target matches at two units.
distinctive_edit_token_contract.uniqueness_rule: Emit a lexical search-priority candidate only when exactly one target in the frozen thirteen-target roster matches.
distinctive_edit_token_contract.association: Exact or Levenshtein-distance-one normalized token evidence only; witnesses union across the frozen three-frame reciprocal sequence.
distinctive_edit_token_contract.authority: Search-priority candidate only; no token, sign, facade, entity, portal, entrance, access, waypoint, arrival, or safety authority.

research_basis: JIST motivates identity-aware joint sequence evidence: https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.19787
Learning Sequential Descriptors motivates sequence-level aggregation for place recognition: https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.03868
SeqNet motivates learned sequence matching across viewpoint and appearance change: https://arxiv.org/abs/2102.11603
The implemented branch is deliberately smaller: conservative high-confidence OCR evidence unioned across a reciprocal three-frame sequence.
execution_rule: Run exactly once. Do not tune or resample after seeing the result; a failure remains a frozen Development result.

claim_boundary.allowed: Fresh same-provider Development evidence about whether the fixed conservative distinctive-token branch transfers to exactly two target-way/item-disjoint, pixel- and OCR-unseen targets across two capture producers in a thirteen-target closed roster.
not_allowed: independent, provider-disjoint, city-disjoint, open-world, conformal, FDR-controlled, distribution-shift, deployment, or safety confirmation
OCR name evidence proving exact physical identity, sign-to-building association, facade ownership, portal ownership, or entrance ownership
access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, or deployment performance
